verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the facilitator's v2 support table listing Base Sepolia, a test network, alongside production Base. That implies developers can run x402 payments against a testnet rather than real funds, but the docs never describe it as a sandbox or testing workflow. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/testnet documentation and setup guidance, test-fund (faucet) or mock-facilitator workflow, statement of isolation from production data, hands-on corroboration of testnet usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The x402 v2 support table lists exact, upto, and batch-settlement on Base ("eip155:8453"), Base Sepolia, Polygon, Arbitrum, and World
